I found no dated AI prediction by Jensen Huang from 2019 that I could confirm in his own words. All three fixed searches ran and none turned one up, so 2019 counts as a quiet year.

- **What came up:** The fixed searches returned mostly coverage from 2024 to 2026 rather than anything from 2019.
- **August 2019 VentureBeat interview:** The VentureBeat page wouldn't open. A full reprint of the interview on Hitecher (Aug 20, 2019) did open. In it Huang says AI is "the largest technology force of our time" and describes AI moving into vertical industries and then autonomous machines. None of it names a year or a length of time.
- **GTC China, December 2019:** A news report on the keynote quotes him saying "everything that moves will be autonomous some day." That has no date, and it isn't about when AGI arrives, so it doesn't count even as undated.
- **Orin production in 2022:** HyperAI's write-up of the same keynote says Orin chip production was planned to start in 2022. That's a chip product schedule, which the rules exclude, and the page gives it only as a paraphrase, not a quote.
- **Pages that wouldn't open:** VentureBeat, HPCwire's March 2019 GTC write-up, and Glasp's CES 2019 transcript. I've quoted nothing from them.
- **Gaps:** I couldn't get a transcript of the March 2019 GTC keynote or the CES 2019 press event. Those are the most likely places a dated 2019 claim could still be hiding.
